newsitem.title: FRANCE: ONIC sees rise in 96/97 French soft wheat exports.
newsitem.headline: ONIC sees rise in 96/97 French soft wheat exports.

text.p: French cereals office ONIC confirmed on Wednesday it had set a target of 6.7 million tonnes for French soft wheat exports to countries outside the European Union in the new 1996/97 season (July/June).
This would compare with a provisional 3.7 million tonnes of soft wheat exported to non-EU destinations in 1995/96.

In its August-September report released ahead of its monthly news conference, ONIC said France would end the 1996/97 season with a soft wheat carryover of 2.19 million tonnes against 2.23 million at end 1995/96. Soft wheat exports to the rest of the EU were put at 8.0 million tonnes against 8.6 million in 1995/96.

Barley exports to non-EU destinations were seen jumping to 1.8 million tonnes from 221,000 tonnes in 1995/96, but barley exports to the rest of the EU may decline to 1.93 million tonnes from 2.24 million.
France should end the 1996/97 campaign with a barley carryover of 736,000 tonnes against 629,000 tonnes in 1995/96.
Maize exports to non-EU destinations were put at between 400,000 and 1.4 million tonnes against 164,000 in 1995/96.
ONIC also targets a maize carryover of between 1.981 million and 2.981 million tonnes against 1.653 million in 1995/96.
